$schema-note: W6 finding 7 (pre-merge adversarial review of ADR 0063). One row per tree in the 2026-09-04 audit corpus (_local/audit/2026-09-04_fable-5-1-max/corpus/manifest.json, 46 trees). `deserves`, `categories`, and `justification` are transcribed verbatim from docs/reference/health-score.md's own table, which is the fixed-before-any-measurement source of truth (ADR 0063 sec 4's ordering requirement) - this file does not reassign a single label, it only makes the same assignments machine-readable and ties them to what is actually present on disk under this directory.
labelReference: docs/reference/health-score.md, section "Calibration: method, corpus, and a divergence from the ADR this change must record"
materializationNote: `materialized: true` means the tree is a tracked directory under tests/fixtures/audit-corpus-labelled/ (this directory) or tests/fixtures/audit-corpus/ (the two falsifiable-test hold-outs). `materialized: "builder"` means the tree is reproduced at test time by a tmpdir-building function rather than committed as static files - used for 17-secret-in-skill-and-hook, whose body carries an AWS-example-style access key whose shape risks tripping a secret scanner or push-protection rule on this repository even though the value is AWS's own publicly documented placeholder pair (see 17-secret-in-skill-and-hook.builder.mjs's header for why even that builder never writes the pattern as one contiguous literal). Every other `false` entry's source tree is not present anywhere under _local/audit/2026-09-04_fable-5-1-max/corpus/ either (its manifest `root` points under corpus/_local/ or corpus/plugins/h*, neither of which exists on disk) - it was never available to copy, not excluded by choice.
